mapper.sql: id, admin_id, title, content, is_top, status, publish_time, create_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM notice WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY is_top DESC, publish_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice (admin_id, title, content, is_top, status, publish_time) VALUES (#{adminId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{isTop}, #{status}, #{publishTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE notice SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, is_top = #{isTop}, status = #{status}, publish_time = #{publishTime} WHERE id = #{id}
